desc: The SR22 pistol is lightweight (just 17.5 ounces) and perfect for just about anything-plinking, target shooting and even small game hunting. It's a reliable, fun-to-shoot .22 LR pistol. Light double-action and crisp single-action trigger pulls. Polymer frame with two interchangeable rubberized grips. Aerospace-grade aluminum slide. 3-dot sight system. Stainless steel replaceable barrel.
